consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for two minutes giving a friend advice about a course or a trip they can't decide on. Note two or three ideas first — the notes are not read out.
requisitos: Two pieces of advice in different forms (week 3)
One way of asking someone to repeat, if you speak with a person (week 4)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Read your corrections from weeks 2 to 9. Write down the mistake marked most often, and one line on why it happens.
*Wed (5 min).* Write four sentences that avoid that mistake.
*Fri (5 min).* Record two minutes. Then listen and mark the mistake.
autochequeo: Were all three requirements really there?

promptCorreccion: This is a review of three skills at B1 level: giving advice, the second conditional, and conversation repair. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well.
